title: Decision-Relevant Forecast Calibration for Predictive Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.21203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Calibration evidence for a predictive controller need not remain valid when operating-context frequencies change. We develop an audit and certification procedure for a declared family of context-density shifts, with a frozen predictor/controller and unchanged conditional outcome law. Coverage requires calibrated tests to span density-weighted selected-plan sensitivities. A residual Gram matrix yields the minimum augmentation rank and an optimal test budget for uncovered $L_2$ geometry. This optimum need not minimize bias over probability-feasible conditional means. For finite contexts, an asymmetric absolute-loss dual and directional linear programs enclose the continuous worst-shift feasible bias. Intersecting simultaneous moment intervals with the conditional-mean domain gives a further certificate and a linear program for selecting an operating shift after validation. translated_title: 面向预测控制的决策相关预测校准
translated_abstract: 预测控制器的校准证据在操作环境频率发生变化时未必仍然有效。我们针对一类声明的环境密度偏移，在预测器/控制器保持冻结且条件结果规律不变的条件下，开发了一种审计与认证程序。覆盖性要求经校准的检验能够张成密度加权的所选方案敏感度。残差Gram矩阵给出了最小增广秩以及针对未覆盖$L_2$几何结构的最优检验预算。该最优解不一定能在概率可行的条件均值范围内最小化偏差。对于有限环境，非对称绝对损失对偶与方向性线性规划可以包络连续最坏偏移下的可行偏差。将联立矩区间与条件均值域相交，可给出进一步的认证，以及一个用于在验证之后选择操作偏移的线性规划。在一项设计的240环境研究中，两个谱方向移除……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种预测控制器校准的审计与认证程序，利用残差Gram矩阵确定最小增广秩与最优检验预算，并通过非对称绝对损失对偶和线性规划包络最坏偏移下的可行偏差，从而在环境密度偏移下认证校准有效性并选择操作偏移。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an audit and certification procedure verifying that a frozen predictive controller's calibration remains valid under declared context-density shifts, using residual Gram matrices for minimum augmentation rank and asymmetric absolute-loss duals with linear programs to bound worst-case feasible bias and select operating shifts.
